title: 第一卷 第15章 临场爆发第一卷 第16章 呼吸法
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
千丈寺的一间破屋内，几个假扮和尚的叛党正围坐在一起。
一个胖和尚满脸慌张：“大哥，怎么办？外面全是官兵，我们被包围了！”
“慌什么？我自有办法让你们脱身。”
被称作大哥的男子面黄肌瘦，眼神里透着淫邪，即便穿着僧袍，也毫无出家人的模样。
胖和尚紧紧抓住他的手：“真的？”
“我骗你做什么？”
男子咧嘴一笑，露出一口黄牙，枯瘦的手指了指身下的蒲团，道：“下面有我提前挖好的密道，你从这里走，我来挡住官兵。”
胖和尚连忙掀开蒲团，底下果然是空的。
他喜出望外：“太好了大哥，我一定带人回来救你们！”
砰！
一根粗木棍狠狠砸在他的头上，浑圆的脑袋瞬间碎裂，尸体重重地摔在地上。
而在寺庙外，随着宋杰一声令下，官兵们立刻发起冲锋。
“冲啊！”
守在寺门口的叛党本就是流离失所的流民，一个个面黄肌瘦、衣衫破烂，手里的刀枪锈迹斑斑、长短不齐，且从未受过半点正规操练。
一见官兵如潮水般猛冲过来，当场吓得魂飞魄散，丢了武器四散奔逃。
双方刚一照面，战局便彻底一边倒，官兵们步步紧逼，成了一场单方面的碾压。
那扇本就腐朽残缺的寺门，在几名士兵合力挺举的巨木撞击之下。
“轰隆”一声被硬生生撞飞，木屑四溅，重重砸在地上，扬起一片尘土。
就在此刻，一道身影突然从门内狂冲而出！
一名叛党手持锈迹斑斑的大刀，双目赤红、状若疯魔，完全不顾生死，嘶吼着直接朝前排官兵横劈猛砍。

官兵猝不及防，瞬间愣神，前排两人躲闪不及，被当场砍翻在地。
但老兵终究是老兵，惊变只在一瞬，立刻回过神，迅速收势、挺刃、结阵，重新稳住阵脚，举刀迎敌。
只是，在场大多数士兵都只是普通士卒，而眼前这名叛党，已然踏入炼体境第二变——肉身强横、力大无穷，受了轻伤也能迅速恢复。
在他疯狂猛扑猛砍之下，十几名官兵竟被打得步步后退，阵形摇摇欲坠。
韩甲看在眼里，猛地提气前冲，脚步踏得地面微微发颤，全身力气灌注于肩背，如一头狂奔的野牛，狠狠撞向那叛党胸口。
“砰——！”
一声闷响。
那叛党只觉胸口一闷，仿佛被疾驰而来的马车正面撞中，整个人瞬间腾空，口喷鲜血，直直倒飞出去。
不等他落地挣扎，周围老兵已一拥而上，刀矛齐下，当场将其围杀。
余下的叛党见状，再无战意，纷纷向外逃窜。
老兵们并未追赶，因为外围还有李毅等人埋伏。
粗壮的古树下，李毅稳立身形，双脚分开扎稳下盘。
他左手托弓，右手扣弦，双臂发力将长弓拉至满月，紧绷的弓弦震颤不休，寒光闪闪的箭镞死死瞄准前方奔逃的叛党。
只听“咻”的一声锐响，利箭脱弦而出，划破长空。
百步开外，逃窜的叛党甚至没来得及做出反应，箭矢便径直洞穿他的身躯。
那人身体猛地一僵，随即重重栽倒在地，当场气绝。
一旁的吴川生目光还停留在倒地的敌人身上，尚未回过神，第二支箭已然破空而去。
又是一声轻响，第二名叛党应声栽落，再无动静。
短短数息功夫，接连数名奔逃之人接连中箭毙命。
content_en:
In a dilapidated room in Qianzhang Temple, several rebels pretending to be monks were sitting together.
A fat monk looked panicked: "Brother, what should we do? There are officers and soldiers outside, and we are surrounded!"
"Why are you panicking? I have a way to get you out."
The man called Big Brother has a sallow complexion and a lustful look in his eyes. Even though he is wearing a monk's robe, he does not look like a monk.
The fat monk held his hand tightly: "Really?"
"What did I lie to you about?"
The man grinned, showing his yellow teeth. He pointed with a skinny finger at the futon under him and said: "There is a secret passage below that I dug in advance. You go from here, and I will stop the officers and soldiers."
The fat monk quickly opened the futon, and it was indeed empty underneath.
He was overjoyed: "That's great, brother, I will definitely bring someone back to save you!"
Bang!
A thick wooden stick hit him hard on the head, the round head instantly shattered, and the body fell heavily to the ground.
Outside the temple, following Song Jie's order, the officers and soldiers immediately launched a charge.
"Come on!"
The rebels guarding the gate of the temple were originally displaced refugees. They were all sallow and thin, and their clothes were in tatters. The swords and guns in their hands were rusty and uneven in length, and they had never received any formal training.
When they saw the officers and soldiers rushing over like a tide, they were so frightened that they lost their weapons and ran away.
As soon as the two sides met, the battle turned completely one-sided. The officers and soldiers pressed forward step by step, and it became a one-sided crushing battle.
The already decayed and incomplete temple door was struck by the huge tree lifted by several soldiers.
With a "bang", he was knocked away violently, sawdust flew everywhere, and hit the ground hard, raising a cloud of dust.
At this moment, a figure suddenly rushed out from the door!
One of the rebels was holding a rusty broadsword, his eyes were red, and he looked like a madman. He roared and slashed at the front row of officers and soldiers with no regard for life or death.
The officers and soldiers were caught off guard and were stunned for a moment. The two people in the front row were unable to dodge and were chopped to the ground on the spot.
But a veteran is a veteran after all. The sudden change only lasted a moment, and he immediately recovered, quickly retreated, straightened the blade, formed a formation, stabilized the position again, and raised the sword to meet the enemy.
However, most of the soldiers present were just ordinary soldiers, but the traitor in front of him had already entered the second transformation of the body refining realm - his physical body was tyrannical and powerful, and he could recover quickly even from minor injuries.
Under his mad attack and slashing, more than a dozen officers and soldiers were beaten back step by step, and the formation was crumbling.
Seeing this, Han Jia suddenly raised his energy and rushed forward. His footsteps made the ground tremble slightly. All his strength was poured into his shoulders and back, like a running wild bull, slamming into the rebel's chest.
"Bang——!"
There was a muffled sound.
The rebel felt a tightness in his chest, as if he had been hit head-on by a speeding carriage. He instantly flew into the air, spitting blood from his mouth, and flew backwards.
Before he could hit the ground and struggle, the surrounding veterans swarmed in and surrounded him with swords and spears, killing him on the spot.
Seeing this, the remaining rebels no longer had the will to fight, and fled away one after another.
The veterans did not pursue them because Li Yi and others were ambushing them outside.
Under the thick old tree, Li Yi stood steadily, with his feet spread apart and firmly planted on his lower body.
He held the bow with his left hand and buckled the string with his right hand. He used both arms to pull the long bow to the full moon. The tight bowstring trembled endlessly, and the cold arrowhead was aimed at the fleeing rebels ahead.
Just hearing a sharp "whoosh" sound, a sharp arrow came out of the string and pierced the sky.
A hundred steps away, the fleeing rebels didn't even have time to react, and the arrow pierced his body.
The man's body suddenly stiffened, and then he fell heavily to the ground and died on the spot.
Wu Chuansheng on the side was still looking at the fallen enemy. Before he could recover, the second arrow had already shot through the air.
There was another soft sound, and the second rebel fell down, and there was no more movement.
In just a few breaths, several fleeing people were shot and killed by arrows one after another.
